h1: Kajabi Alternative in India for Educators (2026): 5 Options, Prices Checked
dek: A fair comparison for Indian educators weighing Kajabi against platforms priced in rupees, with every price taken from the official site and dated, and a straight answer on when Kajabi is still the better tool.
cover_alt: Need a Kajabi alternative in India: Exly, TagMango, Graphy, Kajabi and AllCoaching compared, prices checked on official sites on 24 Oct 2026
audience: Indian educators, coaches and tutors comparing Kajabi with platforms priced in rupees
intro: The best Kajabi alternative in India is the one that fits how your students pay and how much of the academy you want to own: for an educator who wants a website on their own domain, their own Android app (iOS app on Pro) and UPI checkout in rupees, set up without a sales call, AllCoaching is the closest fit. Exly and TagMango suit coaches who sell sessions, memberships and webinars with built-in automation. Graphy suits creators selling to an audience they already have. And Kajabi itself stays a strong choice if you sell worldwide in dollars and use its marketing tools every day.

We are AllCoaching, so read this knowing who wrote it. Every competitor price below comes from that company's own pricing page, with the link and the date we checked it, and we say plainly where another platform fits better than ours.

Kajabi publishes its prices in US dollars: Basic US$179, Growth US$249 and Pro US$499 a month, or US$143, US$199 and US$399 a month when billed annually. It takes no revenue share on your sales, though card processing fees apply. For an Indian educator, Indian GST and your bank's foreign-currency charges may be added on top.
takeaways: Kajabi lists Basic at US$143 a month billed annually (US$1,716 a year) or US$179 month to month, with 0% revenue share, a 7-day free trial and a 30-day money-back guarantee (checked 24 Oct 2026).
Kajabi's prices are in US dollars; Indian GST and foreign-currency card charges may apply, so the rupee cost moves with the exchange rate.

AllCoaching Growth (₹7,999 a month) and Pro (₹14,999 a month) take 0% commission, so you keep 100% of every sale; Starter is ₹6,999 a year plus a 10% fee on sales. GST extra, 7-day free trial with no card.
Exly Starter and TagMango Basic charge no yearly fee but take 10% of sales, so they cost less than AllCoaching up to about ₹8 lakh of sales a year, before their app or custom-domain add-ons.
Your own Android app (iOS app on Pro) is included on every AllCoaching plan; on Kajabi a branded App Store app is on Pro, on Exly the app is an add-on from ₹60,000 a year.
Kajabi is the better fit if most of your buyers pay in dollars and you rely on its email, funnel and membership tools.
You can switch without losing students by running both platforms side by side until current batches finish.

sections.h2: The short answer: pick by what you need
sections.html:
There is no single best Kajabi alternative for every Indian educator. There is a best fit for each way of teaching and selling. Start from the problem you want to solve.

The rest of this guide explains each choice.}}

If you are not sure yet, the next sections show how we compared the options and why Indian educators usually start looking.

sections.html:

sections.h2: Why Indian educators look for a Kajabi alternative
sections.html:
Kajabi is a mature platform, and for many experts it is the right tool. Indian educators usually start comparing for three reasons that have more to do with currency and payments than with features.

What Kajabi does well

Kajabi bundles courses, coaching, memberships, a website, email, funnels and checkout in one product. In its own words: "One subscription runs your whole business, and Kajabi takes no revenue share."[1] If you sell to buyers around the world and use email sequences and funnels every week, that bundle is hard to beat, and its 7-day trial and 30-day money-back guarantee lower the risk of trying it.

1. Paying in US dollars

Kajabi bills in US dollars. Basic billed annually is US$1,716 a year. Paid from India, the rupee amount changes with the exchange rate, your card may add a foreign-currency charge, and Indian GST may apply. None of that is hidden; it is simply harder to plan around when your own students pay ₹499 or ₹2,999 for a batch.

2. Checkout for students who pay by UPI

Most of your NEET, SSC or spoken-English students will expect to pay by UPI, often from a parent's phone. Kajabi's pricing page says card processing fees for Kajabi Payments differ by country and that an extra fee applies if you use a third-party processor where Kajabi Payments is offered. It does not list payment methods, so ask Kajabi directly whether your Indian students can pay by UPI and what the fee is. Our guide to the best UPI payment gateway for online courses explains why this matters at checkout.

{{q:Is Kajabi a bad choice for Indian educators?|No. Kajabi does what it says. Indian educators look elsewhere when most of their buyers are in India and pay in rupees, when the dollar subscription feels heavy before the first sale, or when they want their own Android app (iOS app on Pro) without moving to the top plan.}}

3. Wanting your own app on a lower plan

Kajabi's branded App Store app sits on its Pro plan, at US$499 a month or US$399 a month billed annually. Many Indian students live in apps rather than browsers, so educators who want an app under their own name from day one often compare platforms that include it on every plan.

{{fig:before-after|Before and after: paying in US dollars, questions about UPI checkout, an app only on the top plan, doubts on WhatsApp and Zoom links, compared with one academy login with your own website, app, live classes and UPI checkout|Whatever you choose, the goal is the same: one place for your courses, students and payments, priced in the currency your students use.}}

sections.h2: What each option costs as you grow
sections.html:
A yearly price only tells half the story when a platform also takes a percentage. The chart adds each published rupee plan to its published fee at five sales levels and picks the lowest-cost plan at each level. Kajabi is not on the chart because it prices in US dollars, and we do not convert currencies: its Basic plan billed annually is US$1,716 a year whatever you sell, plus card processing fees.

{{fig:cost|Total yearly cost at ₹50,000 to ₹10 lakh of sales from published rupee prices for AllCoaching, Exly and TagMango|Before GST. Exly and TagMango lines are plan price plus commission only, without the app or custom-domain add-ons; the two lines overlap up to ₹5 lakh.}} {{cost_table}}

The honest reading: on plan price and commission alone, Exly Starter and TagMango Basic cost less than AllCoaching up to about ₹8 lakh of sales a year, because neither charges a yearly fee on those plans. Above about ₹8.4 lakh, AllCoaching Growth at 0% commission, paid yearly (₹79,990), costs less than both.

The picture changes once you add what AllCoaching includes on every plan. With Exly's app add-on (from ₹60,000 a year), Exly Starter costs at least ₹70,000 at ₹1 lakh of sales, against ₹16,999 on AllCoaching Starter. With TagMango's Freedom Setup for a custom domain (₹24,999 a year), TagMango Basic costs ₹18,000 a year more than AllCoaching Starter at every sales level, because both take 10%. Use our plan finder to run your own numbers.

Coach selling 1:1 sessions, webinars and workshops

If most of your income is consultations and events, look closely at Exly or TagMango, whose automation is built around that kind of selling. Compare their add-on prices with what you would actually use.

Expert selling worldwide in dollars

Stay on Kajabi. If you also have a growing Indian audience, you can run an Indian academy alongside it for rupee and UPI buyers. Our guide to building a personal brand as an educator covers how to keep both under one name.

faq: What is the best Kajabi alternative in India?

It depends on how you sell. AllCoaching fits educators who want their own website, Android app (iOS app on Pro) and UPI checkout in rupees, from ₹6,999 a year plus 10% on sales (Starter), or at 0% commission on Growth (₹7,999 a month) and Pro (₹14,999 a month). Exly and TagMango suit coaches selling sessions with automation, Graphy suits creators with an audience, and Kajabi remains a good choice for experts selling worldwide in dollars.
How much does Kajabi cost in India?

Kajabi lists Basic at US$179, Growth at US$249 and Pro at US$499 a month, or US$143, US$199 and US$399 a month billed annually (kajabi.com/pricing-new, checked 24 Oct 2026). Prices are in US dollars, so the rupee cost moves with the exchange rate, and Indian GST and your bank's foreign-currency charges may apply.
Does Kajabi take a commission on sales?

No. Kajabi says it takes no revenue share on any plan. Card processing fees for Kajabi Payments apply and differ by country, and an extra fee applies if you use a third-party processor where Kajabi Payments is offered.
Is there a free Kajabi alternative in India?

Not in the sense of costing nothing. Exly Starter and TagMango Basic charge no yearly fee but take 10% of each sale. AllCoaching gives a 7-day free trial with no card, then plans from ₹6,999 a year plus GST. Kajabi also offers a 14-day free trial.
Is there a Kajabi alternative with UPI payments?

Yes. Every AllCoaching plan includes UPI and card checkout with automatic Razorpay payouts, and TagMango's pricing mentions an Indian payment gateway. Kajabi's pricing page does not list payment methods, so ask Kajabi whether your Indian students can pay by UPI.
Can I get my own Android and iOS app without Kajabi Pro?
Yes. Every AllCoaching plan includes your own white-label Android app (iOS app on Pro), set up by you in the studio. On Kajabi a branded App Store app is part of the Pro plan.
Can I move my Kajabi courses and students to AllCoaching?

Yes. Upload your course videos and notes to your new academy, keep current members on Kajabi until their access ends, send new admissions to your own website and app, then export your records and let the Kajabi plan end at renewal.
Does a Kajabi alternative help me find students?

Mostly no; finding students stays your job on any of these tools. AllCoaching also lists your courses on the AllCoaching marketplace app, which helps discovery, but your own YouTube, Instagram, WhatsApp and website remain the main ways students find you.
